name: CLI A2A Channels
statement: A developer lists all active A2A chat channels and DM threads, seeing thread names, message counts, last activity timestamps, and last sender -- enabling discovery of communication activity across the agent network.
successCriteria: limen a2a-channels returns JSON with count and threads array
Each thread includes lastActivity, messageCount, lastSender, and type fields
Threads sorted by last activity (newest first)
All stdout is valid JSON, all errors go to stderr as JSON
failureCriteria: Threads not sorted by last activity
Any command outputs non-JSON to stdout
preconditions: limen init completed (~/.limen/ exists with master key and config)
